scope: Full Spanish editorial review of EP01–EP05 against all five complete Chinese essay bodies and all five ZIP notes; bounded read-only English presence/absence audit. No English, Chinese, HTML, script, receipt outside this assigned review JSON, or commit edits.

full_read.method: Read all complete texts, not samples or counts. Compared the Spanish argument and example sequence with Chinese. Source-level issues were reported to root instead of silently changing the framework.

self_review.method: Read the complete Spanish texts during the independent comparison; re-read every changed paragraph in context after calibration. Verified the exact sequential edit log by reversing every replacement to reproduce the normalized input SHA256 for all five files.

coverage: Full opening framework: institutional construction, remainder, non-closure, and Washington's personal aspiration.
Inaugural precedent and cabinet development; Hamilton's debt, assumption, residence bargain, bank, and competing historiographies.
Party formation and strife; neutrality, Pacificus/Helvidius, Genêt, Jay Treaty; Whiskey Rebellion procedure and costs.
Enslavement, estate figures, private unease and public conduct; farewell authorship, alliances, retirement, two-term precedent, and complete conclusion.
External French crisis, XYZ Affair, Navy, Quasi-War, and the security-to-repression mechanism.
All four 1798 statutes; Sedition Act sections, safeguards, partisan asymmetry, opinion versus fact, sunset.
Attributed prosecution counts, Lyon and prison reelection, constitutional memory; state resolutions, texts, replies, and later uses.
Adams's peace policy; 1800 deadlock, Twelfth Amendment, transfer, midnight judges, and complete conclusion.
Jefferson's limited-government aims and institutional gravitational-pull framework; inaugural reconciliation and selective inheritance.
Louisiana purchase figures, Napoleon's circumstances, constitutional correspondence, three historiographical readings, and territorial slavery question.
Marbury, Chase, Burr; Barbary force and congressional authorization; Lewis and Clark's scientific, commercial, diplomatic, and imperial functions.
Embargo economic and enforcement costs, backlash; slavery, emancipation scope, racial writings, wolf analogy, import prohibition, and complete conclusion.
Three nested layers: external survival, postwar state capacity, and geographic slavery fracture.
War message, divided votes, Canada, transatlantic timing; military weaknesses, capital burning, portrait rescue, Baltimore symbols.
Second Bank, tariffs, improvements, judicial cases, Panic of 1819; Monroe Doctrine text, limits, background, capacity, and later reinterpretation.
Hartford proposals, party collapse and false unity; Missouri measures, balance, geographic line, Jefferson letter, competing interpretations, and complete conclusion.
Inclusion, expulsion, and presidential expansion as simultaneous processes; the racial boundary argument preserved.
1824 votes and contingent election, corrupt-bargain controversy, Adams's program and coalition limits, 1828 campaign and mobilization.
White male suffrage and Black exclusion; party organization; removal law, political opposition, separate population counts, coercion, and Worcester.
Veto frequency and policy rationale; popular mandate; bank conflict and competing readings; nullification and federal enforcement; Whigs and complete conclusion.

exact_edit_log.old: Fue Marshall quien lo dedujo de la lógica de la Constitución en la sentencia de este caso y lo estableció como precedente. Es decir, la construcción desarrolló un nuevo contrapeso mientras funcionaba; sus diseñadores no lo habían dejado instalado desde el principio.
exact_edit_log.new: El control judicial tenía antecedentes en el pensamiento y en la práctica constitucionales. La sentencia de Marshall convirtió ese razonamiento en un precedente decisivo del Tribunal Supremo. Es decir, la construcción consolidó un contrapeso mientras funcionaba; su alcance no había quedado plenamente fijado desde el principio.
exact_edit_log.reason: Retain the institutional-development argument while acknowledging antecedents.

shared_calibrations.framework_preservation: Institutional construction, remainder, non-closure, gravitational pull, checks, and simultaneous inclusion/exclusion retained throughout.
